field_checks.summary: All current activity rows were enumerated, and Table 2/S1/Figure 3/Figure 6/Supplement Figure S2 surfaces were inspected. The PA-Win2 endpoint values are covered, but Table 2 MIC assay conditions flatten a source conflict: the results paragraph says MIC was assessed at 0.25-256 ug/mL for 18 h, while methods say 0.25-64 ug/mL and 16 h; final MIC/MBC rows preserve only unqualified 16 h.

Thirteen DBAASP Codex fallback candidates were reviewed as unresolved_record; no source_verified database record is claimed because the authoritative linked article/assay/sequence/literature snapshots are empty. This is acceptable only as paper-level evidence, not authoritative ingest.

Paper final contains five JSON records; packet final contains the same five plus mechanism_evidence.json as a byte-identical compatibility alias of mechanism_ontology_record.json. Common paper/packet final files are byte-identical and final review counts report 44 activity, 3 toxicity, 13 database audits, and 6 mechanism claims.

Six mechanism claims preserve ontology boundaries: DiSC3(5) membrane depolarization is the only direct_mechanism claim; time-kill and CV biofilm data remain phenotype_supported; RT-qPCR gene-expression and quorum-sensing effects remain inferred_mechanism; in-silico discovery/modeling remains computational_only.

Paper identity and PA-Win2 entity linkage were source-verified: PMC11672609, PMID 39766503, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics13121113, title match, and Table 1 links TBIU038647 to PA-Win2 sequence LLRGLRYLCLKILYILKLRK. The sequence is 20 residues; no current final object contains both sequence and sequence_length needing a length mismatch repair.

Locator surfaces are present and recursive/path-like source-locator authority was not found, but activity/toxicity normalization is not fully source-faithful: Table 2 MIC rows omit the conflicting xml:p:17 condition locator, and HaCaT toxicity reports raw_value >256 as direct/censored even though the primary text only supports no observed decrease within 0.25 to 256 ug/mL.

Fallback release boundary is preserved: authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, all fallback database candidates remain unresolved_record, no fallback rows are promoted to source_verified or authoritative ingest, recursive authority flags are false, and review open_rework_ticket_count=0 matches the live packet ticket state after 14/14 request IDs closed.

Database cautions are preserved, but the primary-source MIC condition conflict is not: xml:p:17 gives 18 h and 0.25-256 ug/mL, xml:p:44 gives 16 h and 0.25-64 ug/mL, and final Table 2 activity records do not carry this conflict/caution.

The staged supplement ZIP is readable and contains one 9-page PDF. Supplement extraction surfaces cover pages 1-9, Tables S1-S3, 34 S2 condition rows, 14 S3 primer-target rows, and source-reviewed S2 figure observations; extraction_error_count is zero.

Three toxicity records are present and HaCaT/hADMSC/HDFalpha targets are split as mammalian cell lines, but HaCaT raw_value >256 is not a direct primary-source raw value; the source supports no significant cytotoxicity within the tested 0.25 to 256 ug/mL range. hADMSC and HDFalpha >64 thresholds are source-supported.

blocking_findings.reason: The final activity/toxicity record is not publication-grade source-faithful. For PA-Win2 Table 2 MIC/MBC rows, it records a single incubation_time=16 h from methods while omitting the source conflict that the results paragraph states MIC was assessed at 0.25-256 ug/mL for 18 h and methods state 0.25-64 ug/mL for 16 h. It also records HaCaT toxicity raw_value as >256 with direct/censored rationale, while the primary source only reports treatment from 0.25 to 256 ug/mL and no observed HaCaT decrease within that range.
source_locators: xml:p:17: MIC assessed at 0.25-256 ug/mL for 18 h
xml:p:44: MIC method states final peptide concentrations 0.25-64 ug/mL and 16 h incubation; MBC plates 16 h
xml:p:19 and xml:p:20: HaCaT unaffected within 0.25 to 256 ug/mL, hADMSC/HDFalpha decrease above 64 ug/mL
required_actions: Rebuild the Table 2 PA-Win2 MIC/MBC activity records so MIC rows preserve both xml:p:17 and xml:p:44 condition evidence, explicitly marking the 18 h versus 16 h and 0.25-256 versus 0.25-64 ug/mL source conflict instead of using an unqualified 16 h condition.

For MBC rows, keep the Table 2 endpoint values and distinguish endpoint value evidence from method-condition evidence; do not use the method concentration range to contradict source table endpoint values without a conflict note.

Revise the HaCaT toxicity record to represent the source-supported statement as no observed cytotoxicity within 0.25 to 256 ug/mL, or explicitly mark any >256 threshold as an inferred censored lower bound rather than a directly transcribed raw value.
Mirror the repaired activity_toxicity_evidence.json byte-identically to paper final and packet final, then have worker-6 re-adjudicate the repaired lane.
acceptance_checks: A script over both paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json finds no MIC activity record with assay_conditions.incubation_time equal to unqualified 16 h unless xml:p:17/xml:p:44 conflict text or equivalent conflict fields are present.
All Table 2 PA-Win2 endpoint values still match xml:table-wrap:2: B. subtilis 2/2, E. coli 8/32, P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 4/4, S. aureus 256/>256, S. epidermidis 64/>256, MRPA CCARM 2095 2/2 ug/mL.
The HaCaT toxicity object no longer claims direct raw_value >256 without a source-supported censoring rationale tied to xml:p:19/xml:p:20.
Paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json SHA-256 hashes are identical after repair, and final review_report.json open_rework_ticket_count equals the live packet open-ticket count.

cautions.summary: No authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP linked rows are present locally for this paper. The 13 DBAASP fallback candidates are useful paper-level candidates only and must remain excluded from RC2, portal, and authoritative ingest.

Figure-derived biofilm CV and one time-kill value are approximate visual digitizations rather than exact numeric source values; the current activity final marks these exact-vs-approximate statuses, so this is not an additional blocker.
